input.query: Who led the first expedition to the fictional Varrow Glacier?

evidence.text: The fictional Varrow Glacier feeds three mountain lakes.
The Tarn harbor log names Edda Calloway as the sole leader of the first expedition to the fictional Varrow Glacier.
Fictional ice axes of the period had wooden handles.
According to the Bay harbor log, Simeon Thale was the only leader of the first fictional Varrow Glacier expedition.
The fictional lakes below Varrow Glacier freeze every winter.
